info.title: AresPath
info.description:
AresPath — NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 Mars surface routing API.

**Coordinate convention**: Mars, planetocentric latitude, positive-east longitude, −180..180°.

**Display space**: `arespath_display_v1` — X = East (m), Y = North (m), region-specific projection.

get.description: Returns the system health, version, and planetary datum information.

post.summary: Compute a surface route on Mars
post.description:
Compute a surface traversal route between two Mars coordinates.

**Coordinate convention** (must match request `coordinate_reference`):
- body = Mars
- latitude_type = planetocentric
- longitude_direction = positive_east
- longitude_domain = -180_to_180
- angular_unit = degrees

**Route geometry** is returned in the `arespath_display_v1` coordinate
space: X = East metres, Y = North metres, region-specific projection.

**Scientific integrity**: Returns `ROUTING_DATA_UNAVAILABLE` rather than
fabricated routes when verified terrain data is not operational.

503.description: Routing data unavailable for the requested region

get.summary: List all supported Mars surface regions with full metadata
get.description:
Returns the full metadata contract for every registered Mars surface
region, including:
- Source coordinate reference system
- Display projection definition (None where dataset not yet integrated)
- Local display-frame origin
- X/Y axis units
- Transformation method and parameters
- Dataset coverage and provenance

schema.title: Response List Regions Api V1 Regions Get

get.summary: Get metadata for a specific Mars surface region
get.description: Returns the full metadata contract for the requested region.

get.summary: List terrain / map layers available for a region
get.description:
Returns the layer catalogue for the specified region.

**Scientific integrity**: When no verified terrain datasets have been integrated, returns a valid empty catalogue with `verified_layers_available=false` and an explicit `notice`. Never fabricates NASA product IDs, resolution, or coverage data.

**Coordinate consistency**: Every layer embeds the same `arespath_display_v1` coordinate frame as the parent region, ensuring X=East, Y=North (metres) throughout.

200.description: Layer catalogue (may be empty if no verified data)

get.summary: Get full coordinate-frame metadata for a specific layer
get.description:
Returns the full metadata record for a layer, including:
- Coordinate frame (arespath_display_v1)
- Source CRS (Mars, planetocentric, positive-east, −180..180°)
- Projection definition (null until dataset integrated)
- Region-specific display-frame origin (null until dataset integrated)
- Transformation method and parameters (null until dataset integrated)
- Dataset provenance

**Scientific integrity**: Numeric fields are null, not invented, when the underlying dataset has not yet been integrated.

is_synthetic.title: Is Synthetic
is_synthetic.description: True when data is synthetic/placeholder, not real NASA observations

synthetic_description.title: Synthetic Description
synthetic_description.description: If synthetic, describes what real data would replace it

DisplayOrigin.title: DisplayOrigin
DisplayOrigin.description:
Region-specific origin of the arespath_display_v1 local display frame.

NOTE: Actual numeric values depend on the verified terrain dataset for
the region.  Populated from configuration; never invented.

x.title: X
x.description: Easting from region display origin, metres

y.title: Y
y.description: Northing from region display origin, metres

DisplayPoint.title: DisplayPoint
DisplayPoint.description:
A 2-D point in the arespath_display_v1 coordinate space.
  X = East  (metres from region origin)
  Y = North (metres from region origin)

proj4_string.title: Proj4 String
proj4_string.description: PROJ4/PROJ6 string — populated from verified dataset config only

wkt2_string.title: Wkt2 String
wkt2_string.description: OGC WKT2 string — populated from verified dataset config only

semi_major_axis_m.title: Semi Major Axis M
semi_major_axis_m.description: Mars IAU2015 mean volumetric sphere radius (metres)

DisplayProjectionDefinition.title: DisplayProjectionDefinition
DisplayProjectionDefinition.description:
Describes the map projection used for the arespath_display_v1 frame
for a specific region.

NOTE: Actual projection parameters (e.g. standard parallels, false
easting/northing) are dataset-specific and must be populated from
verified configuration files, not invented here.  Fields are typed
Optional and default to None to make the absence explicit.

is_verified.title: Is Verified
is_verified.description: True only when this layer is derived from a verified NASA/ESA scientific dataset.  False for synthetic or placeholder layers.

is_synthetic.title: Is Synthetic
is_synthetic.description: True when data is synthetic/placeholder, not real observations

resolution_m_per_px.title: Resolution M Per Px
resolution_m_per_px.description: Ground sample distance (metres/pixel) — from verified dataset only

data_source.title: Data Source
data_source.description: Dataset identifier or PDS product ID — from verified dataset only

reference_url.title: Reference Url
reference_url.description: URL to the original dataset — from verified source only

LayerCatalogueEntry.title: LayerCatalogueEntry
LayerCatalogueEntry.description:
Summary record returned in the layer catalogue list.

One entry per available layer.  When no verified layers exist the
catalogue list is empty and the response carries an explicit notice.

verified_layers_available.title: Verified Layers Available
verified_layers_available.description: True only when at least one layer with is_verified=True exists for this region.  False when only synthetic/placeholder layers or no layers are registered.

total_count.title: Total Count
total_count.description: Total number of layers in this response

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Layer summary records.  Empty when no verified layers are available.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: Informational notice about layer availability, present when verified_layers_available is False.

LayerCatalogueResponse.title: LayerCatalogueResponse
LayerCatalogueResponse.description:
Response envelope for GET /api/v1/layers?region_id=...

Always returns a valid structure.  When no verified layers exist,
`layers` is an empty list and `verified_layers_available` is False
with an explicit notice.

source_crs.description: Source CRS of the underlying dataset

projection_name.title: Projection Name
projection_name.description: PROJ/OGC projection name — populated from verified dataset config only

proj4_string.title: Proj4 String
proj4_string.description: PROJ4/PROJ6 string — populated from verified dataset config only

semi_major_axis_m.title: Semi Major Axis M
semi_major_axis_m.description: Mars IAU2015 mean volumetric sphere radius (metres)

origin_latitude_deg.title: Origin Latitude Deg
origin_latitude_deg.description: Display-frame origin latitude (planetocentric degrees) — from verified config

origin_longitude_deg.title: Origin Longitude Deg
origin_longitude_deg.description: Display-frame origin longitude (positive-east degrees) — from verified config

transformation_method.title: Transformation Method
transformation_method.description: Transformation method from source CRS to display frame — from verified config

transformation_parameters.title: Transformation Parameters
transformation_parameters.description: Numeric transformation parameters — from verified config only, never invented

LayerCoordinateFrame.title: LayerCoordinateFrame
LayerCoordinateFrame.description:
Coordinate frame metadata attached to every layer.

Mirrors the region-level metadata contract so the frontend can verify
consistency between region and layer without a separate lookup.

NOTE: Numeric parameters (proj4_string, origin coordinates) are null
until a verified dataset is integrated.  Never invented.

availability_note.title: Availability Note
availability_note.description: Human-readable note on data availability status

LayerMetadata.title: LayerMetadata
LayerMetadata.description:
Full metadata record for a single layer, returned by
GET /api/v1/layers/{layer_id}/metadata.

Satisfies the coordinate metadata consistency contract:
  - Projection definition
  - Region-specific origin
  - Transformation method and parameters
  - Source CRS metadata

All numeric projection / transformation fields are null until a verified
dataset is integrated.

LayerType.title: LayerType
LayerType.description:
Categories of terrain / map layer.

Values are machine-readable identifiers used in filtering and display.

MarsCoordinateReference.title: MarsCoordinateReference
MarsCoordinateReference.description:
Canonical Mars coordinate reference used in every request and
embedded in every metadata response.

MarsPoint.title: MarsPoint
MarsPoint.description:
A Mars surface coordinate in the confirmed convention:
  planetocentric latitude, positive-east longitude, degrees, -180..180.

source_crs.description: Source coordinate reference system for all input coordinates

routing_available.title: Routing Available
routing_available.description: True only when verified terrain data and routing service are operational

routing_unavailable_reason.title: Routing Unavailable Reason
routing_unavailable_reason.description: Machine-readable reason code when routing_available is False

RegionMetadata.title: RegionMetadata
RegionMetadata.description:
Full metadata block for a Mars surface region, satisfying the metadata
contract defined in the AresPath PRD.

region_id.title: Region Id
region_id.description: Identifier for the Mars surface region (e.g. 'jezero_crater')

start.description: Start coordinate in confirmed Mars convention

destination.description: Destination coordinate in confirmed Mars convention

coordinate_reference.description: Must match the confirmed AresPath Mars convention

route_id.title: Route Id
route_id.description: Unique identifier for this computed route

region_id.title: Region Id
region_id.description: Region the route was computed within

algorithm.description: Routing algorithm that produced the route

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Non-fatal advisory messages about data quality

data_sources.title: Data Sources
data_sources.description: Dataset identifiers used to compute this route

hazard_count.title: Hazard Count
hazard_count.description: Number of identified hazard zones crossed

method.title: Method
method.description: Transformation method name, e.g. 'Equirectangular projection + local offset'

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: Numeric parameters — populated from verified config only, never invented

TransformationParameters.title: TransformationParameters
TransformationParameters.description:
Documents the mathematical transformation from the source dataset CRS
to the arespath_display_v1 local frame.

Parameters are populated only from verified dataset documentation.
